title: The Pack-Ice Charter
summary: Windhelm charter crews stranded on the Atmoran ice shelf must appease the ancient Whale and Bear totem-wards around the Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs when frost-wrights lock the pack-ice channel.

hook.rumour: The sea-lane behind the charter anchorage froze solid in a single hour of green aurora, and the captains say the bronze Whale-Totem at the Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs has been turned backward.
hook.notice: ATMORAN CHARTER CAMP: Hardy hands needed to march to the Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs and relight the Whale and Bear beacon-braziers.

npcs.name: Warden of Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs
npcs.greet: The sea-lane behind the charter anchorage froze solid in a single hour of green aurora, and the captains say the bronze Whale-Totem at the Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs has been turned backward.
talk: The trouble across the Atmoran Ice Waste began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs.
If you mean to help the Windhelm Charter Expedition, start by checking the trail between Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs and Wolf Jarls Howe.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Wolf Jarls Howe is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Wolf Jarls Howe toward The Frozen Dragon Mound before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs so Ice-Pilot Torsten Frost-Keel can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of The Frozen Dragon Mound
npcs.greet: You made good time from Wolf Jarls Howe. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Rimefang Cave.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Rimefang Cave with a picked guard.
Once Rimefang Cave is cleared, return to Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs
npcs.greet: Ice-Pilot Torsten Frost-Keel awaits word on whether the crisis in the Atmoran Ice Waste has been contained.
talk: The elders of Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Atmoran Ice Waste owes you a debt for standing between Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs and ruin.
